recognize_zh: 切片中央可見一個嗜伊紅性、玻璃樣化的小結節，周圍的小淋巴球呈同心圓排列，背景是瀰漫的小淋巴球及間質中許多玻璃樣化的小血管；萎縮、玻璃樣化的生發中心加上間質血管增生，是 Castleman 病的線索。
features: Small atretic follicle with a central eosinophilic, hyalinized germinal center (center of field)
Small lymphocytes arranged concentrically around the hyalinized center
Diffuse sheets of small lymphocytes with admixed cells that may include plasma cells (not resolvable at this power)
Numerous interfollicular small vessels with hyalinized, eosinophilic walls
Focal black pigment/debris adjacent to the follicle, likely artifact or pigment deposit
describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue shows a small atretic follicle with a hyalinized, eosinophilic germinal center surrounded by concentrically arranged small lymphocytes. The interfollicular region contains diffuse small lymphocytes and prominent small vessels with hyalinized walls. Focal black pigment near the follicle is likely artifactual. Although the stated magnification is x400, cellular detail is limited in this image, so plasma cell content and HHV-8-positive plasmablasts cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease with regressed, hyalinized germinal centers; LANA-1 (HHV-8) immunostaining and clinical correlation are needed to classify the disease as multicentric and HHV-8-associated.

ddx.vs: Shows identical regressed follicles and hyalinized vessels, so distinction from MCD depends on clinical extent (single site) and HHV-8 negativity.
Can show involuted, hyalinized germinal centers with vascular proliferation, but occurs in HIV-positive patients with follicle lysis and lacks sheets of plasma cells.
May have Castleman-like follicles, but features increased IgG4+ plasma cells (IgG4/IgG ratio >40%), often with eosinophils and elevated serum IgG4.
Shows regressed follicles and prominent high endothelial venules but also atypical clear T cells with a TFH phenotype and expanded follicular dendritic meshworks around vessels.
